info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-List Hotel Rooms Pricings-v5-spec
info.description: This API enables users to retrieve detailed pricing information for hotel rooms. It provides a comprehensive list of available room options, including their respective prices and availability status. Typical consumers include travel agencies, booking platforms, and mobile applications aiming to enhance their offerings with real-time hotel data. The API is designed to facilitate seamless integration into various applications, helping users make informed decisions when planning their stays.

get.description: This endpoint allows developers to fetch detailed pricing information for available rooms, aiding in the booking process and helping users make informed decisions.

requestBody.description: Request body for the pricing information related to rooms. This endpoint allows users to retrieve the pricing structure, including any applicable discounts or special offers that may be available at the time of the request.
